name: copilot-credit-analytics
description: Monitors GitHub Copilot credit & token usage, calculates workday-based daily budgets, tracks extra credits & debt, identifies expensive 40-60%+ chat sessions, and visualizes model, workspace & multi-month history analytics.

commands.title: Copilot Analytics: Set Monthly & Extra Credits
Copilot Analytics: Export Monthly Report (JSON / CSV)

copilotAnalytics.monthlyCredits.description: Base monthly Copilot credits (e.g., 300 for Copilot Pro, 1500 for Pro+, 50 for Free). Auto-updated from GitHub API when signed in unless overridden.

copilotAnalytics.overrideApiEntitlement.description: If true, always use copilotAnalytics.monthlyCredits instead of the entitlement returned by GitHub's API.

copilotAnalytics.extraCredits.description: Additional purchased or topped-up credits available for the current month.

copilotAnalytics.workDays.description: Days of the week counted as workdays (0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday, ..., 6 = Saturday).

copilotAnalytics.workHoursPerDay.description: Number of work hours in a standard workday (used to compute work-hour averages).

copilotAnalytics.holidays.description: List of non-working holiday dates in YYYY-MM-DD format to exclude from monthly workday calculations.

enumDescriptions: Calculates daily % against your Debt/Extra-Adjusted Daily Limit (spreads extra credits & debt across remaining workdays).
Calculates daily % against the fixed Base Daily Limit (Monthly Credits / Total Workdays).
copilotAnalytics.dailyPercentMode.description: Determines whether the primary status bar % uses the debt/extra-adjusted daily limit or fixed base daily limit.

copilotAnalytics.colorStatusBarBackgroun.description: Applies green, yellow, orange, or red background fill with high-contrast white/dark text to the bottom-right status bar widget.

copilotAnalytics.expensiveSessionMinPerc.description: Minimum % of the Recommended Daily Limit consumed in a single chat session to flag it as an Expensive Chat (40-60% Heavy tier).

copilotAnalytics.expensiveSessionMaxPerc.description: Upper threshold % of the Recommended Daily Limit separating Heavy (40-60%) sessions from Mega/Critical (>60%) sessions.

copilotAnalytics.modelMultipliers.description: Credit cost multiplier per message for each AI model substring.
